note.p: The painter John Opie (who was rumoured to have been courting Mary Wollstonecraft before her relationship with Godwin – see St Clair, p. 163 and 173) married Amelia Alderson, the novelist, poet and daughter of a Norwich doctor, in 1798. Godwin had contact with both Amelia and John (who painted Wollstonecraft’s portrait in 1797 where she is seen pregnant with Mary). Entries with ‘Opie’ have been coded as John, whereas the ‘Opies’ after marriage are taken to include both John and Amelia. A A, Mes Opie, etc have been coded as Amelia.
Opie appears in the 1796 lists under 1795 which accords with his first appearance in the diary - the only previous reference is 'see Opie's pictures' back in 1788.
